summary.text: Shawn Olorundami is an English teacher and the Democratic candidate for Iowa House of Representatives District 1 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Josh Steinhoff.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is campaigning on public education, families, workers and health care.

paragraphs.text: Olorundami earned a high school diploma from West High School and a bachelor's degree from Buena Vista University in 2009, and his career experience includes working as an English teacher.

In the survey, Olorundami listed priorities including fully funded public education, an end to the state's school voucher program, paid parental leave, universal pre-kindergarten, restored collective bargaining rights, a higher minimum wage, and expanded Medicaid.
He listed the Iowa Federation of Labor, AFL-CIO as an endorser.
